claims.text: Grants support the growth and development of sculpture across historical, modern and contemporary registers.
Grants fund exhibitions.
Grants fund commissions.
Grants fund acquisitions.
Grants fund research.
Grants fund conferences.
Grants fund publications.

UK and international non-profit organisations are eligible to apply for exhibitions, exhibition catalogues, commissions, conferences, research, non-commercial publications and the development of collections through acquisitions, conservation, cataloguing and display.
Individual sculpture historians, academics and conservators can apply to the Research and Travel category.
Individuals independently wishing to create, inform, develop or research their own practice are not eligible.
Community project applications will only be considered when the applicant is a non-profit arts organisation.
The maximum grant for New Projects and Commissions is £20,000.
The maximum grant for Acquisitions and Collections is £20,000.
The maximum grant for Conferences, Lectures and Publications is £5,000.
The maximum grant for Long-Term Research grants is £20,000.
The maximum grant for Research and Travel grants is £2,500.
Applications are considered four times per year.
Autumn submissions close 1 September.
Winter applications open 1 November and close 1 December.
Spring applications open 1 February 2027 and close 1 March 2027.
Summer applications open 1 May 2027 and close 1 June 2027.
Registration requests must be received one week before the deadline.
The Artist Award Scheme is not a grant that can be applied for.
